verdict.rationale: Codegen documents triggering agents programmatically from CI/CD pipelines through its API ("Trigger agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail") and a Python SDK with `agent.run(prompt=...)`, so a pipeline script can start cloud agents without interaction. The documented CLI, however, is described mainly as an interactive TUI, and the docs show no headless or non-interactive shell mode, exit-code semantics, or CI setup guide. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI invocation for shell scripts, CI integration examples (e.g. a GitHub Actions workflow), exit codes or blocking-wait semantics, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts
